pure-announcement.rationale: An educational deep dive on continuous profiling as a technique; it covers Parca but is not a launch, release note or funding notice.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts cover SIEM gaps, SLO alerting and retrieval topics; none covers continuous profiling or the profile-versus-trace distinction.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Its mechanisms (kernel stack sampling, DaemonSet architecture, OTel Profiling SIG work) are checkable against the public project docs and posts it cites.

durability.rationale: The profile-versus-trace distinction, statistical-sampling economics and adopt/wait/skip criteria age well even though the Parca-vs-Pyroscope matrix and AI-tooling asides will date.

actionability.rationale: It gives tool-agnostic decision rules — adopt when compute cost is a major line item, start with the most expensive services, make profiles per-team self-service — that change how a reader would roll profiling out.

atomicity.rationale: One promotable idea (eBPF profiling fills the function-level gap metrics and traces leave) is bundled with a vendor comparison table and a speculative AI-tools section that need stripping.
